rationale: The stock is at 98.8% of its intraday range with only 35 minutes to close, sitting just $0.02 below the session high — this is an extremely extended position with minimal reward-to-risk for a long entry and no clear reversal signal to justify a short. With forced liquidation at close and the price already up ~10% from the prior close, the asymmetric risk of a late-day fade outweighs the marginal continuation potential.
